title: Ferroni 2025 · Depersonalisation and looming PPS
citation: Ferroni, F., Arcuri, E., Ardizzi, M., Chinchella, N., Gallese, V., & Ciaunica, A. (2025). Lost in time and space? Multisensory processing of peripersonal space and time perception in people with frequent experiences of depersonalisation. Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology, 78(6), 1177–1194.
notes: Preview the published paired delay, silent D0 and catch examples. The conflicting trial totals prevent a full assessment reconstruction.

published_method.cohort: 70 adults stratified into groups of 35 using low (≤20) and high (≥50) Cambridge Depersonalisation Scale scores.
published_method.sessions: Counterbalance the PPS and mental time travel tasks on the same day. The time travel task measures temporal judgment in the same study and has a distinct design.
published_method.response: Detect a single pulse applied to the hairy side of the right index finger, while blindfolded with right palm down. Ignore the looming and flat sounds and respond quickly to touch.
published_method.analysis: Compare reaction times across five sound-relative delays. Estimate PSE and DL from trimmed reaction-time means and compare the score groups.
published_method.sound: 3 s stimuli sampled at 44.1 kHz. For looming, the far output decreases and the near output increases. Supplement places the speakers 100 cm apart.
published_method.touch_setup: Paired electrodes and a Digitimer DS3 deliver a single 100 μs pulse in the supplementary settings. Individual adjustments appeared above threshold. The main text and supplement describe electrical output differently.
published_method.response_hardware: Left index finger at keyboard. Missed target trials repeat.
published_method.allocation: Main text reports 60% paired trials, with tactile baselines and sound-only catches making up the rest. Supplement prints two blocks, 120 total trials and 18 targets per delay by sound, figures that do not imply the stated proportions.

reference_parameters.preview_scope: Timing exemplars only. Per example block: ten paired sound-by-delay rows, two sound-only catches and one silent D0 row. The toolkit sets these demonstration counts.
